about: One conformance corpus for kitlib tmp (ompkit-41l85, KITLIB-TMP v1), read by tests/cli/kitlib-tmp.test.ts (src/kitlib/tmp.ts and scripts/kitlib-tmp.sh) and tests/scripts/kitlib_tmp_test.py (scripts/kitlib_tmp.py). For each case and language the test runs a small child program (defined in the test file) as `child ACTION ROOT [LABEL]`, where ROOT is a directory the test creates and removes. The child makes two owned dirs (labels kitlib-a, kitlib-b) under ROOT, prints each path on its own stdout line, then performs ACTION: exit0 (exit 0), fail (ts throw, py raise, sh exit 3), sigterm/sigint/sighup (signal itself), wait (print `ready`, then sleep until the test SIGKILLs its process group), cleanup-twice (cleanup() each dir twice, print `cleaned`, exit 0), bad-label (try LABEL; on refusal print `REFUSED` on stdout with the error on stderr, exit 0). expect keys: rc (exit status; an object maps language to status) or signal (the child died of this signal), dirs (gone: both dirs and nothing else are absent from ROOT; kept: exactly the two dirs remain, each with a .owner parseable as an owner record whose pid is the dead child's pid), stdout_has, stderr_has (substrings). planted_negatives re-run a case with the child's signal hook removed after the dirs exist (a test-only child variant, never a library switch); the case's judgement must FAIL.
